title: More than one non-human species, not all benevolent

tellings.quote: another thing uh that not every spec there were more than one species and there weren't all as benevolent as

plain: Richard Barth, a former guard at a US nuclear missile site, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about being taken by non-human beings around September 1964 at Vandenberg, an Air Force base in California. He says he learned that more than one non-human species was involved, and that not all of them were as kind as the ones he met. If true, it would mean that whatever is visiting us is not one friendly group but several, with different aims.
